definition: County code. Primary key. FARS writes the same number in its COUNTY element.
source: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS county codes (equal to the GSA codes FARS uses, in Florida).
allowable_values: The 67 Florida codes: odd numbers 1-133 except 25, plus 86 (Miami-Dade). CHECK 1-133; the seed script fixes the exact set.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: County name without the word County.
allowable_values: 67 distinct names; unique; no leading or trailing spaces.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: County the estimate belongs to. Part of the primary key; foreign key to county.
source: Census county population totals, Vintage 2025: COUNTY.
allowable_values: A county_fips that exists in county.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Year of the July 1 estimate. Part of the primary key.
source: Census Vintage 2025: the year in POPESTIMATE2020 ... POPESTIMATE2024 (columns unpivoted to rows).
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Resident population on July 1 of that year. Denominator of every fatality rate.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Census release the number came from (2025 = Vintage 2025). Census revises the whole series every year, so the release has to be on record.
source: Set by the pipeline from the file name (CO-EST2025-ALLDATA).
allowable_values: From the estimate year up to 2030; an estimate for year Y first appears in Vintage Y.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Census block group identifier in 2010 geography: state (2 digits) + county (3) + tract (6) + block group (1). Primary key.
source: EPA Smart Location Database v3: GEOID10.
allowable_values: 12 digits starting with 12 (Florida); stored as text so leading zeros survive.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: County the block group lies in. Generated by the database from digits 3-5 of geoid10, so it cannot be typed in and cannot disagree with the GEOID. Foreign key to county.
allowable_values: A county_fips that exists in county.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: National Walkability Index: how much the built environment favors walking, from 1 (least) to 20 (most). Binned into EPA's four classes in v_ped_transactions.
source: EPA Smart Location Database v3: NatWalkInd.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Street intersection density: weighted intersections per square mile, with auto-oriented intersections left out.
source: EPA Smart Location Database v3: D3B.
null_meaning: EPA published no value for this block group.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Distance from the population-weighted center of the block group to the nearest transit stop, in meters.
source: EPA Smart Location Database v3: D4A.
allowable_values: 0 or more. EPA's filler -99999 is rejected by a CHECK.
null_meaning: No transit stop within three-quarters of a mile (EPA writes -99999). It is not a distance, so it is stored as NULL and never averaged.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Population of the block group as shipped with the index (2018 American Community Survey).
source: EPA Smart Location Database v3: TotPop.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: FARS element the code belongs to, in lower case (for example lgt_cond). Part of the primary key.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: The numeric code as it appears in the FARS files. Part of the primary key.
allowable_values: Any code listed for that element.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: First crash year in which the label is valid. Part of the primary key.
source: FARS Analytical User's Manual (code lists are given by year range).
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Last crash year in which the label is valid.
allowable_values: year_from-2024. Default 2024. An EXCLUDE constraint stops two labels for one code from overlapping in time.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: What the code means, in NHTSA's wording.
source: FARS Analytical User's Manual; Pedestrian Bicyclist Crash Typing Manual.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: True when the code means not reported or unknown. Lets one query measure missingness for any element.
source: Set by hand from the manual when the label is entered.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Pedestrian crash group: the broad scenario (for example 750 = crossing roadway, vehicle not turning). Primary key.
source: FARS/CRSS Pedestrian Bicyclist Crash Typing Manual: PEDCGP.
allowable_values: The 16 pedestrian groups 100-990. Group 0 (not a pedestrian) is left out.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Name of the crash group.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Pedestrian crash type: the detailed scenario (for example 760 = pedestrian failed to yield). Primary key.
source: Pedestrian Bicyclist Crash Typing Manual: PEDCTYPE.
allowable_values: The 55 pedestrian types 120-910. Type 0 (not a pedestrian) is left out.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Name of the crash type.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: The one crash group this type belongs to. Foreign key to pbcat_group. This is why ped_crash_type stores the type only.
source: Pedestrian Bicyclist Crash Typing Manual (type-to-group table).
allowable_values: A pedcgp that exists in pbcat_group.
sensitivity: Public. Published reference data; safe for the public repository.

definition: Crash year. With st_case it identifies the crash, because FARS starts its case numbers over every year.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: FARS case number: state code (12) followed by a four-digit sequence. Unique within one year only.
allowable_values: 120001-129999. The range also enforces the Florida scope (STATE = 12).
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: County where the crash happened. Foreign key to county. Mandatory, so every death lands in a county rate.
allowable_values: A county_fips that exists in county. The FARS fillers 0, 997, 998, and 999 have no match and are rejected.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Month of the crash. The day of the month is not loaded: the question does not need it, and leaving it out makes a row harder to match to a news report.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Day of the week.
allowable_values: 1 = Sunday ... 7 = Saturday. FARS has no unknown code for this element after 2009.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Hour of the crash on the 24-hour clock. Binned into time of day in v_ped_transactions.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Rural or urban land use at the crash site. The analysis view keeps code 2 (urban).
allowable_values: 1 rural; 2 urban; 6 trafficway not in state inventory; 8 not reported; 9 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Functional class of the road: the road class in the project question. The analysis view drops 1-2 (interstates and other freeways).
allowable_values: 1 interstate; 2 other freeway or expressway; 3 other principal arterial; 4 minor arterial; 5 major collector; 6 minor collector; 7 local; 96 not in state inventory; 98 not reported; 99 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Where the crash happened relative to a junction (crash level). The pedestrian's own location is pedloc in ped_crash_type.
allowable_values: 1 non-junction; 2 intersection; 3 intersection-related; 4 driveway access; 5 ramp-related; 6 railway crossing; 7 crossover-related; 8 driveway-access-related; 16 shared-use path crossing; 17 acceleration/deceleration lane; 18 through roadway; 19 other location in interchange; 20 entrance/exit ramp; 98 not reported; 99 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Light condition: the lighting in the project question.
allowable_values: 1 daylight; 2 dark, not lighted; 3 dark, lighted; 4 dawn; 5 dusk; 6 dark, unknown lighting; 7 other; 8 not reported; 9 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Prevailing atmospheric condition.
allowable_values: 1 clear; 2 rain; 3 sleet or hail; 4 snow; 5 fog, smog, smoke; 6 severe crosswinds; 7 blowing sand or dirt; 8 other; 10 cloudy; 11 blowing snow; 12 freezing rain; 98 not reported; 99 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Latitude of the crash in decimal degrees. Used once, for the block-group join, and never shown on a map as a point.
allowable_values: 24.3-31.1 (Florida's bounding box). Must be filled together with longitud.
null_meaning: FARS gave a filler instead of a position: 77.7777 not reported, 88.8888 not available, 99.9999 unknown. All three mean no usable point.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Longitude of the crash in decimal degrees (FARS spelling).
allowable_values: -87.7 to -79.8 (Florida's bounding box). Must be filled together with latitude.
null_meaning: FARS gave a filler instead of a position: 777.7777, 888.8888, or 999.9999.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Census block group the crash point falls in. Foreign key to block_group. Not a FARS field: the pipeline derives it with a point-in-polygon join in geopandas.
source: Derived by the pipeline from latitude, longitud, and the EPA block-group polygons.
allowable_values: A geoid10 that exists in block_group. Allowed only when the coordinates are filled (CHECK).
null_meaning: Not geocoded: the crash has no usable point, or the point falls outside every Florida block group. The death still counts in its county.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Name or route number of the road, as written by the police. Used for corridor labels after aggregation.
null_meaning: FARS left the trafficway identifier blank.
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Number of people who died in the crash, all person types. Reconciliation only: it must be at least the number of pedestrian rows loaded for the crash.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Number of people in the crash who were not in a motor vehicle (pedestrians, cyclists, and others, including survivors). Reconciliation only.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Crash year. Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to crash.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Case number of the crash the vehicle was in. Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to crash.
allowable_values: A (year, st_case) that exists in crash.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Number of the vehicle inside its crash. Part of the primary key. Only motor vehicles in transport are loaded.
allowable_values: 1-999. 0 is reserved for people outside vehicles.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Body type of the vehicle. Grouped into vehicle classes in v_ped_transactions.
allowable_values: 1-99 (NHTSA body type codes, not contiguous); 98 not reported; 99 unknown. Since 2020 pickups are 34; codes 30 and 31 are no longer used.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Posted speed limit, in mph, on the road this vehicle was traveling: the posted speed in the project question. FARS records it per vehicle, which is why it lives here and not in crash.
allowable_values: 0 = no statutory limit; 5-95 mph; 98 not reported; 99 unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Whether the vehicle left the scene.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Crash year. Part of the primary key and of both foreign keys.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Case number of the crash the person died in. Part of the primary key and of both foreign keys.
allowable_values: A (year, st_case) that exists in crash.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Vehicle number of the person. Always 0, which is how FARS marks a person outside any vehicle. Kept in the key so the key matches the FARS person key.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Number of the person among the people outside vehicles in that crash. Part of the primary key.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Number of the vehicle that struck the pedestrian. With year and st_case it is a foreign key to vehicle, so the striking vehicle is always a vehicle of the same crash.
allowable_values: 1-999, and the vehicle must exist in the same crash. 0 is rejected.
null_meaning: No striking vehicle in this database: FARS coded 0, or the number names a vehicle that is not in the VEHICLE file. The death is kept; its speed-limit, vehicle-class, and hit-and-run items read unknown.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Person type. Kept as a guard on the scope: the CHECK accepts pedestrians only.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Injury severity. Kept as a guard on the scope: the CHECK accepts fatal injuries only.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Age in years. Used in four groups only (under 18, 18-34, 35-64, 65 or older).
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Sex as recorded by the police.
allowable_values: 1 male; 2 female; 8 not reported; 9 unknown. (NHTSA withdrew a code 3 from the 2022 file in 2025.)
sensitivity: Restricted. Quasi-identifier: together with age, sex, and place it could single out a victim. Never published at case level.

definition: Whether the police reported alcohol involvement for this person. Sensitive: used only to check that the roadway patterns also hold without these cases, never as a rule condition and never in a published table.
sensitivity: Restricted. Sensitive attribute about a victim. Used only as a stratifier inside the local database (proposal, section 10).

definition: Crash year. Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to pedestrian.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Case number. Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to pedestrian.
allowable_values: A pedestrian key that exists in pedestrian.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Always 0 (person outside a vehicle). Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to pedestrian.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Person number. Part of the primary key and of the foreign key to pedestrian. Because the primary key equals the pedestrian key, one pedestrian has at most one typing record.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case key: it points to the record of a real death. Stays in the local database.

definition: Whether a marked crosswalk was present at the crash site.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Whether a sidewalk was present at the crash site.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Where the pedestrian was relative to an intersection: the crossing location in the project question.
allowable_values: 1 at intersection; 2 intersection-related; 3 not at intersection; 4 non-trafficway location; 9 unknown. Code 7 (not a pedestrian) is rejected.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Where the pedestrian was on or near the road when struck.
allowable_values: 1 intersection area; 2 crosswalk area; 3 travel lane; 4 paved shoulder, bike lane, or parking lane; 5 sidewalk, shared-use path, or driveway access; 6 unpaved right-of-way; 7 non-trafficway driveway; 8 non-trafficway parking lot or other; 9 other or unknown. Code 77 (not a pedestrian) is rejected.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.

definition: Pedestrian crash type: what the pedestrian and the driver were doing. Foreign key to pbcat_type, which also gives the crash group.
allowable_values: A pedctype that exists in pbcat_type (55 types). Code 0 (not a pedestrian) is rejected.
sensitivity: Restricted. Case-level value; only aggregates leave the local database.
